articles.title: Induction and consolidation atezolizumab with stereotactic body radiation therapy versus radiation alone in high-risk, early-stage non-small-cell lung cancer (SWOG/NRG S1914): a multicentre, open-label, superiority, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Daly ME, Simone CB, Redman MW, Hsieh MH, Hesketh PJ, Hu C, Monjazeb AM, Steuer CE, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) is the standard of care for early-stage, medically inoperable non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We aimed to test the addition of neoadjuvant, concurrent, and adjuvant atezolizumab with SBRT for early-stage NSCLC.
abstract.textZh: 立體定向身體放射治療(SBRT)是早期、醫學上無法手術的非小細胞肺癌(NSCLC)的標準治療。我們的目標是測試新輔助藥物、同時藥物和輔助藥物atezolizumab加SBRT治療早期NSCLC。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial, eligible patients from 146 institutions across the USA who had T1-T3N0M0 NSCLC ≤7 cm, and were medically inoperable or declined surgery, and had at least one risk factor suggestive of increased risk of recurrence, were included in the study. Patients underwent open-label equal and stratified randomisation to SBRT over three to eight fractions with or without up to eight cycles of neoadjuvant, concurrent, and adjuvant atezolizumab 1200 mg intravenously every 21 days for up to eight cycles, with SBRT initiated with cycle three. The primary objective was to compare overall survival between the two groups. The group sequential design included four interim analyses. Target accrual was 480 patients (432 eligible). The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04214262) and is closed to new participants.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、開放標籤、3期、隨機對照試驗中，本研究納入了來自美國146個機構的合格患者，這些患者的T1-T3N0M0 NSCLC ≤ 7 cm ，且在醫學上無法手術或手術拒絕，並且至少有一個提示復發風險增加的風險因素。患者接受開放標籤相等和分層的隨機分組至SBRT超過三至八個分次，最多有或沒有八個週期的新輔助、同時和輔助阿特珠單抗1200 mg靜脈注射，每21天一次，最多八個週期， SBRT在第三個週期開始。主要目的是比較兩組之間的總生存期。羣組序列設計包括四項期中分析。目標累積為480名患者（ 432名符合資格）。該試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT04214262 ）註冊，並不對新參與者開放。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 25, 2020, and Sept 9, 2024, 417 patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to atezolizumab plus SBRT (n=210) or SBRT alone (n=207). 402 were eligible and made up the modified intention-to-treat population (201 per group). The median age was 72·8 years (IQR 67·4-78·4), 218 (54%) of 402 participants were female, and 184 (46%) were male. Accrual closed at the first interim analysis of all randomly assigned participants for futility with 76 progression-free survival (PFS) events and 41 deaths among 400 eligible participants (200 per group). An updated analysis was performed with 140 PFS events, 92 deaths, and a median of 24·8 months (range 0·1-64·9; IQR 18·6-36·0) of follow-up among living patients. The overall survival hazard ratio was 1·04 (95% CI 0·69-1·58; one-sided p=0·58). Estimated 2-year overall survival was 82% in both groups (95% CI 75-87). Grade 3 or higher adverse event rates were 12% with atezolizumab plus SBRT and 3% with SBRT. Two grade 5 respiratory events occurred in the atezolizumab plus SBRT group.
abstract.textZh: 在2020年3月25日至2024年9月9日期間，招募了417名患者，並將其隨機分配到atezolizumab加SBRT （ n = 210 ）或單獨SBRT （ n = 207 ）。402名患者符合資格，並構成了調整的意向治療人羣（每組201名）。 中位年齡為72 · 8歲（ IQR 67 · 4-78 · 4 ） ， 402名參與者中有218名（ 54 ％ ）為女性， 184名（ 46 ％ ）為男性。 累計結束於所有隨機分配參與者的第一次期中分析，無效，在400名合格參與者（每組200人）中發生了76例無惡化生存（ PFS ）事件和41例死亡。 對140例PFS事件、92例死亡和中位數為24 · 8個月（範圍0 · 1-64 · 9 ； IQR 18 · 6-36 · 0 ）的活患者進行了更新的分析。 整體生存風險比為1 · 04 （ 95% CI 0 · 69-1 · 58 ；單側p = 0 · 58 ）。 兩組的估計2年總生存率為82% （ 95% CI 75-87 ）。 使用atezolizumab加SBRT的3級或更高的不良事件發生率為12% ，使用SBRT的不良事件發生率為3%。 Atezolizumab + SBRT組中發生兩起5級呼吸事件。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In the first fully reported phase 3 cooperative group trial to assess immunotherapy in inoperable early-stage NSCLC, we observed no improvement in overall survival with atezolizumab plus SBRT, and more grade 3 or higher adverse events were reported with atezolizumab combined with SBRT.
abstract.textZh: 在第一次完全報告的評估無法手術的早期NSCLC免疫治療的3期合作羣組試驗中，我們觀察到使用atezolizumab加SBRT的總生存期沒有改善，並且使用atezolizumab加SBRT報告了更多3級或更高的不良事件。

articles.title: The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
articles.authors: Ross JS, Hockemeyer KG, Redin E, Rudin CM

abstract.text: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease. Of particular note, defining cell-surface proteins that are uniquely or differentially expressed in SCLC has led to various targeted therapies showing substantial preliminary evidence of efficacy in patients with SCLC. Approaches in active development include T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, radioconjugates, and cell therapies, among others. In this Series paper, we summarise current standards of care, recent advances, and highlight emerging approaches showing early promise for better management of SCLC. Together, these advances are providing new hope for patients with what has been a particularly lethal disease.
abstract.textZh: 小細胞肺癌（ SCLC ）是一種極具侵襲性的惡性腫瘤：診斷時具有高度增殖性、異質性和經常轉移性。 雖然最初對化療有反應，但這種反應通常是短暫的，復發性疾病對標準細胞毒素基本上是難治的。 過去十年來，我們對SCLC生物學的理解取得了重大進展，這一臨牀前進展現在為這種疾病的多種新型治療方法提供了信息。 特別值得注意的是，定義在SCLC中獨特或差異表達的細胞表面蛋白導致各種靶向療法顯示出在SCLC患者中有效的實質性初步證據。 積極發展的方法包括T細胞接合劑、抗體-藥物偶聯物、放射性偶聯物和細胞療法等。 在本系列論文中，我們總結了當前的護理標準，最近的進展，並強調了新興方法，這些方法顯示了更好地管理SCLC的早期前景。 這些進展共同為患有特別致命疾病的患者提供了新的希望。

articles.title: Liposuction versus conservative therapy for patients with lipoedema in Germany: a multicentre, randomised controlled clinical trial
articles.authors: Podda M, Schmidt J, Cornely ME, Steinmetz MI, Rajewski D, Busch KH, Taufig Z, Ghods M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Lipoedema is a painful, chronic disease of the subcutaneous adipose tissue, predominantly affecting women. Conservative complex decongestive therapy is the standard of care but offers limited symptom relief. Liposuction appears to be a promising approach but lacks evidence of effectiveness and safety. The aim of this trial was to show superiority of liposuction compared with conservative therapy regarding relevant pain reduction with reasonable safety.
abstract.textZh: 脂肪水腫是一種痛苦的慢性皮下脂肪組織疾病，主要影響女性。保守複雜的緩解充血療法是標準的護理，但提供有限的症狀緩解。抽脂似乎是一種有希望的方法，但缺乏有效性和安全性的證據。本試驗的目的是在相關疼痛減輕方面顯示吸脂與保守治療相比的優越性，並具有合理的安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicentre, randomised controlled trial at 11 German centres, eligible women with stage I, II, or III lipoedema and leg pain of at least 4 points on a 0-10 numeric rating scale received conservative therapy for up to 7 months and then were randomly assigned to liposuction or conservative therapy (2:1) stratified by lipoedema stage and study site. For all visits involving an assessment, patches were applied to the legs of all patients, and patients were instructed not to reveal the treatment they had received, in order to mask the assessor. The primary endpoint was reduction of patient-reported leg pain by at least 2 points after 12 months, and missing assessment was considered non-successful.The primary outcome was analysed in the intention-to-treat population which included all randomly assigned patients, and safety analysis included all enrolled patients. A long-term follow-up of 36 months is ongoing. This study is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04272827.
abstract.textZh: 在這項在11個德國中心進行的多中心、隨機對照試驗中，符合條件的I、II或III期脂肪水腫和腿部疼痛在0-10數值評分量表中至少4分的婦女接受保守治療長達7個月，然後被隨機分配到按脂肪水腫分期和研究中心分層的抽脂或保守治療(2: 1)。對於涉及評估的所有覆診，所有患者的腿部都貼上貼片，並指示患者不要透露他們接受的治療，以掩蓋評估人員。主要終點是患者報告的腿部疼痛在12個月後減少至少2分，缺失評估被認為不成功。在包括所有隨機分配患者的意向治療族羣中分析主要結果，安全性分析包括所有入組患者。正在進行為期36個月的長期隨訪。本研究的注冊地址爲ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04272827。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Of 1973 patients screened between Jan 19, 2021, and June 7, 2022, 453 were enrolled, and 410 were randomly assigned to the liposuction group (n=278) or to the conservative therapy group (n=132). All 410 patients were included in the intention-to-treat analysis (mean age 42·9 [ SD 10·6]; ethnicity data were not collected). After 12 months, 190 (68%) of 278 randomisly assigned patients undergoing liposuction achieved the primary endpoint of pain reduction versus ten (8%) of 132 randomly assigned to conservative therapy (odds ratio 26·2 [95% CI 13·1-52·5]; p<0·0001). Adverse events occurred in 124 (47%) of 265 patients undergoing liposuction, and 20 (8%) of 265 were rated as serious. In the conservative therapy group, 30 (21%) of 145 patients reported adverse events, and five (3%) 145 were rated as serious. Secondary endpoints regarding quality of life showed greater improvement in the liposuction group.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年1月19日至2022年6月7日期間篩選的1973名患者中，有453名入組， 410名隨機分配到抽脂組（ n = 278 ）或保守治療組（ n = 132 ）。所有410名患者均被納入意向性治療分析（平均年齡42 · 9 [SD 10 · 6] ；未收集族裔資料）。12個月後， 278名隨機分配的患者中有190名(68%)達到減輕疼痛的主要終點，而132名隨機分配到保守治療的患者中有10名(8%)達到減輕疼痛的主要終點(比值比26 · 2 [95% CI 13 · 1-52 · 5] ； p < 0 · 0001)。265名接受吸脂手術的患者中有124名(47%)發生不良事件， 265名患者中有20名(8%)被評為嚴重不良事件。在保守治療組中， 145名患者中有30名（ 21 ％ ）報告了不良事件， 5名（ 3 ％ ） 145被評為嚴重。有關生活品質的次要終點顯示，抽脂組有較大改善。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Liposuction was superior to conservative therapy in reducing leg pain and improving quality of life in patients with lipoedema, but was associated with a higher rate of serious adverse events. Liposuction has the potential to be a promising treatment option for patients with lipoedema.
abstract.textZh: 抽脂在減輕脂肪水腫患者的腿部疼痛和改善生活質量方面優於保守治療，但與嚴重不良事件發生率較高有關。吸脂術有可能成為脂肪水腫患者的有希望的治療選擇。

articles.title: Cardiovascular disease in pregnancy: physiology, global burden, risk stratification, and opportunities in care
articles.authors: Brazile TL, Conrad N, Bergman L, Gnanaraj JP, Mehta LS, Silversides CK, Sliwa K, Sharma G, et al.

abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease remains one of the leading causes of maternal mortality worldwide and a major driver of long-term morbidity. Yet, pregnancy-related cardiovascular complications are often under-recognised and variably managed across global settings. This three-part Series examines the continuum of cardiovascular risk surrounding pregnancy-from preconception through to lifelong surveillance. In the first paper in this Series, we describe the haemodynamic changes of pregnancy and global trends of congenital and acquired heart disease before pregnancy, evaluate established risk-stratification tools, and discuss the importance of multidisciplinary care. We focus on the existing burden of cardiovascular disease during pregnancy and related maternal and fetal complications. The second paper focuses on hypertensive disorders of pregnancy-the most common cardiovascular complication during pregnancy worldwide-detailing the pathophysiology, risk factors, and innovative care-delivery models to bridge gaps in longitudinal management. Finally, the third paper examines the association between adverse pregnancy outcomes and future cardiovascular disease, delineating mechanistic pathways, early interventions, and subsequent cardiovascular care. Together, this Series underscores pregnancy as a pivotal window into women's lifelong cardiovascular health and calls for integrated, equitable strategies to prevent avoidable maternal and fetal complications, while substantially lowering the lifetime risk of cardiovascular disease across diverse populations.

articles.title: Adverse pregnancy outcomes and long-term cardiovascular disease risk
articles.authors: Pabón MA, Smith G, Sharma G, Catov J, Lewandowski AJ, Adam S, Honigberg MC, Cardiovascular Disease in Pregnancy Writing Group

abstract.text: Pregnancy provides a unique physiological stress test for the cardiovascular system, during which, adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) can unmask latent susceptibility to future disease. Common complications, including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP), gestational diabetes, and preterm birth (delivery before 37 weeks' gestation), identify women at substantially higher long-term risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality compared with women without a history of APOs. These excess risks likely reflect the combined effects of pre-existing cardiometabolic and genetic susceptibility, as well as the haemodynamic and metabolic stressors of pregnancy, heralding accelerated risk factor trajectories, relative impairment in endothelial and microvascular function, and early disease onset. This final Review in the Series extends the focus from cardiovascular disease during pregnancy and HDP to the long-term cardiovascular implications of APOs after delivery. We synthesise epidemiological data quantifying cardiovascular risk across major APO phenotypes and emerging evidence linking maternal APO history with cardiometabolic risk trajectories in offspring. We also delineate putative mechanistic pathways and summarise guidelines and consensus-informed recommendations for short-term and long-term follow-up after APOs. Finally, we propose practical approaches for integrating APO history into cardiovascular disease risk assessment and guideline-directed prevention across the female life course. We highlight key knowledge gaps, including uncertainty about optimal follow-up models, the limitations of current risk-stratification tools, and the absence of APO-specific prevention trials. We also outline priorities for mechanistic and implementation research. Positioning APOs as early, sex-specific indicators of cardiovascular risk offers a key window of opportunity to shift prevention upstream and improve cardiovascular health outcomes for women.
abstract.textZh: 懷孕為心血管系統提供了獨特的生理壓力測試，在此期間，不良妊娠結果（ APO ）可以揭示未來疾病的潛在易感性。 常見的併發症，包括妊娠高血壓症（ HDP ）、妊娠糖尿病和早產（妊娠37週前分娩） ，與沒有APO病史的婦女相比，確定長期心血管疾病發病率和死亡率高得多的婦女。 這些過度風險可能反映了先前存在的心臟代謝和遺傳易感性的綜合影響，以及懷孕的血液動力和代謝壓力因素，預示著危險因素軌跡加速，內皮和微血管功能相對受損以及早期疾病發作。 本系列的最終審查將重點從懷孕期間的心血管疾病和HDP擴展到分娩後APO的長期心血管影響。 我們綜合流行病學數據，量化主要APO表型的心血管風險，以及將母體APO歷史與後代心臟代謝風險軌跡聯繫起來的新證據。 我們還描述了假定的機制路徑，並總結了APO後短期和長期跟進的指導方針和共識建議。 最後，我們提出將APO病史整合到女性心血管疾病風險評估和指南導向預防中的實用方法

articles.title: Safety and lipoprotein(a)-lowering effects of Kylo-11, a non-canonical, long-duration small interfering RNA targeting lipoprotein(a): a first-in-human, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 1 trial
articles.authors: Sarraju A, Du X, Zhou L, Laffin LJ, Wolski K, Gu Y, Liu Z, Zhang Q, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Elevated lipoprotein(a) concentrations are associated with the development of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. The aim of this study was to evaluate the safety and lipoprotein(a)-lowering effects of Kylo-11, a very long-acting small interfering RNA that targets lipoprotein(a).
abstract.textZh: 脂蛋白(a)濃度升高與動脈粥樣硬化性心血管疾病的發展有關。本研究的目的是評估Kylo-11的安全性和降低脂蛋白(a)的效果， Kylo-11是一種針對脂蛋白(a)的非常長效小的幹擾RNA。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 1 trial was performed in a single hospital-based site in China in adults aged 18-55 years with elevated lipoprotein(a) concentrations who were otherwise healthy. Participants were randomly assigned to receive a single, subcutaneous dose of Kylo-11 or placebo (8:2) across seven dosing cohorts. Kylo-11 recipients could enter conditional extension follow-up up to day 337, whereas placebo recipients were followed up to day 169. Participants with lipoprotein(a) concentrations of 75-200 nmol/L were enrolled into cohorts 1-6 (ie, doses of 9, 30, 75, 225, 450, and 600 mg). Participants with lipoprotein(a) concentrations of more than 200 nmol/L were enrolled into cohort 7 (225 mg). The randomisation schedule was generated by an unmasked statistician with no involvement in study conduct, efficacy or safety analyses, or blinded data analysis, and assigned to treatment groups by an interactive web response system. Participants, investigators, and study personnel were masked to cohort assignment. The primary endpoint was the incidence of investigator-assessed adverse events within 24 weeks. All randomly assigned participants who received a dose of investigational product were included in the safety analysis set. All randomly assigned participants who received a dose of Kylo-11 and had at least one pharmacodynamic datapoint were included in the pharmacodynamic analysis set. Missing data were not imputed. The trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06363851) and is now complete.

articles.title: Robotic-arm-assisted versus conventional total knee replacement (RACER-Knee): a pragmatic, multicentre, participant-masked and assessor-masked, superiority, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Parsons H, Metcalfe A, Griffin J, Khatri C, Bradley H, Blyth M, Clement N, Croft N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Robotic systems are being increasingly used to assist with total knee replacement (TKR). Whether robotic systems improve outcomes after TKR is uncertain. We aimed to ascertain the clinical efficacy and cost-effectiveness of the Mako robotic-arm system compared with conventional instruments for TKR.
abstract.textZh: 機器人系統正被越來越多地用於協助全膝關節置換術（ TKR ）。機器人系統是否能改善TKR後的結果尚不確定。我們的目標是確定MAKO機器人手臂系統與傳統TKR儀器相比的臨牀療效和成本效益。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a participant-masked and assessor-masked pragmatic, superiority, randomised controlled trial at ten hospitals in Great Britain involving 33 surgeons. Patients with advanced knee osteoarthritis underwent TKR with conventional instruments (cTKR) or with the Mako robotic-arm-assisted system (rTKR). Key exclusion criteria were inflammatory arthropathy, previous fracture, or the need for complex implants. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) through a remote computer system using minimisation by age, BMI, centre, surgeon, and primary knee compartment involved. Participants and assessors were masked through methods including using sham incisions, additional draping, and masked operation notes. The primary outcome was the Forgotten Joint Score (FJS) at 12 months after randomisation according to the intention-to-treat principle using a linear mixed-effects model. The prespecified target difference was 12 points. The trial is registered with ISRCTN (ISRCTN27624068), and long-term follow-up is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: 我們在英國的十家醫院進行了一項參與者蒙面和評估者蒙面的務實、優越、隨機對照試驗，涉及33名外科醫生。 晚期膝關節骨性關節炎患者使用傳統儀器（ cTKR ）或MAKO機器人手臂輔助系統（ rTKR ）進行TKR。 關鍵排除標準是炎性關節病、既往骨折或需要複雜的植入物。 參與者通過遠程計算機系統隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ） ，使用年齡， BMI ，中心，外科醫生和所涉及的主要膝蓋隔間的最小化。 參與者和評估人員被遮蔽的方法包括使用假切口、額外的覆蓋和遮蓋的操作說明。 主要結果是根據意向治療原則使用線性混合效應模型在隨機分組後12個月時的遺忘關節評分（ FJS ）。 預先指定的目標差異為12分。 該試驗已在ISRCTN （ ISRCTN27624068 ）註冊，並且正在進行長期隨訪。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 21, 2021, and Dec 13, 2023, 807 patients were screened and 339 were randomly assigned: 168 to rTKR and 171 to cTKR. The median age was 68·8 years (IQR 61·3-75·2), 167 (49%) were female, and 172 (51%) were male. At 12 months, the mean FJS was 49·2 (SD 28·4; n=154) in the rTKR group and 50·2 (29·9; n=158) in the cTKR group. The adjusted mean difference was -1·5 (95% CI -7·5 to 4·5; p=0·62,) favouring cTKR. 16 participants in each group had one serious adverse event.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In this pragmatic trial, rTKR as delivered in routine practice was more costly than cTKR and did not provide a clinically meaningful patient benefit at 12 months after randomisation. The two groups had similar safety (ie, harms) profiles.

articles.title: Pulmonary Nodules
articles.authors: Callister MEJ, Silvestri GA

abstract.text: Pulmonary nodules are classified as solid or subsolid, with subsolid nodules further classified as part-solid or pure ground-glass. Management strategies differ according to the type of nodule. A comparison of current and previous imaging studies, when available, is essential to assess the risk of the nodule being malignant. Solid nodules that have been stable for 2 years are considered to be benign, whereas subsolid nodules require a longer period of stability to be considered benign. Prediction models to stratify the risk of the nodule being malignant can be used to guide the management of solid nodules. Computed tomographic (CT) surveillance is indicated for low-risk nodules; positron-emission tomography-CT, biopsy, or both for intermediate-risk nodules; and surgical resection for selected high-risk nodules. Subsolid nodules are often slower growing than solid nodules but are associated with a higher risk of being malignant, especially if a solid component develops or progressively enlarges. Biopsy methods include transthoracic needle biopsy and navigational bronchoscopy. Optimal overall management balances timely diagnosis in persons who have cancer with the avoidance of unnecessary invasive procedures in persons who have benign disease.

articles.title: Daraxonrasib for Previously Treated RAS-Mutant Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
articles.authors: Arbour KC, Punekar S, Luo J, Johnson M, Spira A, Herzberg B, Starodub A, Sommerhalder D, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: RAS mutations, as a group, are the most common oncogenic drivers of non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and they occur in approximately 30% of patients. Whether daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) - an oral RAS(ON) multiselective, tri-complex inhibitor of guanosine triphosphate-bound mutant and wild-type RAS protein isoforms - is safe and effective in patients with RAS-mutant NSCLC is unknown.
abstract.textZh: RAS突變作為一組，是非小細胞肺癌（ NSCLC ）最常見的致癌驅動因素，它們發生在約30 ％的患者中。daraxonrasib (RMC-6236)是一種口服的RAS (ON)多選擇性、三複合體的鳥苷三磷酸結合突變型和野生型RAS蛋白同工型抑制劑，對RAS突變型NSCLC患者是否安全有效尚不清楚。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 1-2, multicenter, dose-escalation and dose-expansion study of daraxonrasib, we enrolled patients with previously treated advanced RAS-mutant NSCLC and administered daraxonrasib in doses of 10 to 400 mg orally once daily in 21-day cycles. The primary end point was safety. Secondary end points included investigator-assessed objective response (complete or partial response) and the duration of response, with response assessed according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1.
abstract.textZh: 在這項daraxonrasib的1-2期、多中心、劑量遞增和劑量擴大研究中，我們招募了先前治療的晚期RAS突變型NSCLC患者，並在21天週期中每天一次口服daraxonrasib ，劑量為10至400 mg。主要終點是安全性。次要終點包括研究人員評估的客觀緩解（完全或部分緩解）和緩解持續時間，並根據實體腫瘤緩解評估標準1.1版評估緩解。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: As of the data-cutoff date of July 21, 2025, a total of 136 patients with NSCLC who had been enrolled and treated with daraxonrasib at doses of 300 mg or less had been evaluated for safety and efficacy. Adverse events of any grade occurring with a dose of 300 mg or less, regardless of attribution, were reported in 99% of the patients, with rash, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and mucositis or stomatitis occurring in at least 30% of patients. Adverse events of grade 3 or higher were reported in 54% of the patients, with pneumonia (in 10%), diarrhea (in 9%), rash (in 8%), and anemia (in 5%) occurring in at least 5% of patients; four grade 5 adverse events occurred. The percentage of patients who had an objective response was 31% with daraxonrasib at a dose of 120 mg or less, 34% at doses of 160 to 220 mg, and 37% at a dose of 300 mg.

abstract.text: Among patients with previously treated metastatic RAS-mutant NSCLC receiving daraxonrasib at a dose of 300 mg or less daily, 54% had adverse events of grade 3 or higher, and antitumor activity was reported in more than 30%. articles.title: Azacitidine-Venetoclax or Induction Chemotherapy for Acute Myeloid Leukemia
articles.authors: Fathi AT, Perl AE, Fell GG, Jonas BA, Ragon BK, Mims AS, Borate U, Mannis GN, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Induction chemotherapy has long been a key component of curative therapy for fit patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML), despite its frequently severe side effects and substantial health care utilization. For patients who are ineligible for induction chemotherapy, hypomethylating therapy plus venetoclax is the standard treatment owing to its efficacy and side-effect profile.
abstract.textZh: 長期以來，誘導化療一直是急性髓性白血病（ AML ）患者治療性治療的關鍵組成部分，儘管其經常出現嚴重的副作用和大量醫療保健利用。對於不符合誘導化療資格的患者，由於其療效和副作用特徵，低甲基化治療加venetoclax是標準治療。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, phase 2 trial, we randomly assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, previously untreated adults with AML who were eligible for induction chemotherapy to receive either azacitidine plus venetoclax or induction chemotherapy. Patients with core binding factor fusions, mutations in the gene encoding FMS-like tyrosine kinase 3 (FLT3), or mutations in the gene encoding nucleophosmin-1 (NPM1; unless the patient was ≥60 years of age) were excluded. The primary end point was event-free survival.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心2期試驗中，我們以1: 1的比例隨機分配有資格接受誘導化療的既往未治療的AML成人接受阿扎胞苷加venetoclax或誘導化療。排除核心結合因子融合、編碼FMS樣酪氨酸激酶3 （ FLT3 ）的基因突變或編碼核磷蛋白-1的基因突變（ NPM1 ；除非患者年齡≥ 60歲）的患者。主要終點是無事件存活期。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 172 patients underwent randomization, with 86 patients assigned to each group. The median age of the patients was 64 years. A total of 72% of the patients had adverse-risk disease according to the European LeukemiaNet 2022 classification. At a median follow-up of 21.9 months, the median event-free survival was 14.5 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 10.4 to 24.4) in the azacitidine-venetoclax group, as compared with 6.2 months (95% CI, 4.1 to 10.1) in the induction chemotherapy group, corresponding to a hazard ratio for event or death of 0.57 (95% CI, 0.39 to 0.84; P = 0.002 by the stratified log-rank test). Infection of grade 3 or higher occurred in 28% of the patients (95% CI, 19 to 39) receiving azacitidine-venetoclax and in 41% of those (95% CI, 30 to 52) receiving induction chemotherapy; hemorrhage of grade 3 or higher occurred in 2% (95% CI, 0.3 to 8) and 12% (95% CI, 6 to 20), respectively.
abstract.textZh: 共有172名患者接受隨機分組，每組分配86名患者。患者的年齡中位數為64歲。根據European LeukemiaNet 2022分類，共有72%的患者患有不良風險疾病。在中位隨訪21.9個月時， Azacitidine-venetoclax組的中位無事件生存期為14.5個月（ 95%置信區間[CI] ， 10.4至24.4 ） ，而誘導化療組為6.2個月（ 95% CI ， 4.1至10.1 ） ，相應於事件或死亡風險比為0.57 （ 95% CI ， 0.39至0.84 ；根據分層對數秩檢測， P = 0.002 ）。3級或更高的感染發生在28%接受阿扎胞苷- venetoclax的患者（ 95% CI ， 19至39 ）和41%接受誘導化療的患者（ 95% CI ， 30至52 ） ； 3級或更高的出血分別發生在2% （ 95% CI ， 0.3至8 ）和12% （ 95% CI ， 6至20 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In this phase 2, randomized trial, azacitidine-venetoclax therapy led to significantly longer event-free survival than induction chemotherapy among induction-eligible patients with AML. (Funded by AbbVie and others; PARADIGM ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04801797.).

articles.title: Phase 3 Trial of Oral Infigratinib in Children with Achondroplasia
articles.authors: Savarirayan R, Hoover-Fong J, Irving M, Arundel P, de Bergua JM, Campeau PM, Candler T, Cocanougher BT, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Achondroplasia is a genetic skeletal condition caused by FGFR3 pathogenic variants. Infigratinib, an oral FGFR1-3 tyrosine kinase inhibitor, down-regulates key pathways in the pathogenesis of achondroplasia.
abstract.textZh: 軟骨發育不全是一種由FGFR3病原變異體引起的遺傳性骨骼疾病。Infigratinib是一種口服FGFR1-3酪氨酸激酶抑制劑，下調軟骨發育不良發病機制的關鍵途徑。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, we randomly assigned children with achondroplasia (3 to 17 years of age) in a 2:1 ratio to receive infigratinib (at a dose of 0.25 mg per kilogram of body weight) or placebo once daily for 52 weeks. The primary end point was the change from baseline in the annualized height velocity in the infigratinib group as compared with the placebo group at week 52. Key secondary end points were the change from baseline in the height z score and in the upper-to-lower body segment ratio at week 52. The primary analysis evaluated the treatment effect at week 52 in the full analysis population, with missing data handled with a prespecified imputation approach.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In all, 114 patients underwent randomization: 75 patients to receive infigratinib (with 1 withdrawal before treatment) and 39 patients to receive placebo. The difference between infigratinib and placebo in the least-squares mean change from baseline to week 52 was 1.74 cm per year (95% confidence interval [CI], 1.31 to 2.17; P<0.001) for the annualized height velocity, 0.32 (96% CI, 0.23 to 0.41; P<0.001) for the height z score, and -0.02 (96% CI, -0.06 to 0.01) for the upper-to-lower body segment ratio. Adverse events occurred in 71 of 74 patients (96%) in the infigratinib group and in 37 of 39 patients (95%) in the placebo group; serious adverse events occurred in 4 of 74 patients (5%) and 1 of 39 patients (3%), respectively. No serious adverse events or adverse events leading to treatment discontinuation were considered by the investigator to be related to infigratinib or placebo.

articles.title: Balanced Fluid or 0.9% Saline in Children Treated for Septic Shock
articles.authors: Balamuth F, Weiss SL, Long E, Thompson GC, Artis AS, Campos AB, Borland ML, Dalziel SR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether treatment with balanced crystalloid fluid leads to better outcomes than 0.9% saline in children treated for septic shock is debated.
abstract.textZh: 在接受敗血性休克治療的兒童中，使用平衡結晶體液進行治療是否會比0.9%生理鹽水產生更好的結果是有爭議的。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this pragmatic clinical trial conducted at 47 emergency departments in five countries, patients (2 months to <18 years of age) with suspected septic shock and abnormal perfusion were randomly assigned to receive fluid resuscitation with either balanced fluid or 0.9% saline for up to 48 hours. The primary outcome was a major adverse kidney event (a composite of death, new renal-replacement therapy, or persistent kidney dysfunction) at 30 days after enrollment or hospital discharge, whichever occurred first.
abstract.textZh: 在這項在五個國家47個急診科進行的實用臨牀試驗中，懷疑感染性休克和灌注異常的患者（ 2個月至< 18歲）被隨機分配到使用平衡液體或0.9%生理鹽水進行液體復甦長達48小時。主要結果是入組或出院後30天發生的重大不良腎臟事件（死亡、新的腎臟替代療法或持續性腎功能障礙的複合症） ，以先發者為準。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 9041 enrolled patients, 277 (6.1%) in the balanced-fluid group and 282 (6.2%) in the 0.9%-saline group withdrew from the trial, leaving 4235 and 4247 patients, respectively, for analysis. A primary-outcome event occurred in 137 patients (3.4%) in the balanced-fluid group and in 124 (3.0%) in the 0.9%-saline group (difference, 0.4 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.5 to 1.3; risk ratio, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.88 to 1.40; P = 0.85). The median number of hospital-free days during 28 days after enrollment was 23 (interquartile range, 19 to 25) in both groups. Hyperchloremia occurred in 868 patients (31.4%) in the balanced-fluid group and in 1383 (49.0%) in the 0.9%-saline group; hypernatremia in 52 (1.8%) and 89 (3.1%), respectively; and hyperlactatemia in 260 (19.8%) and 228 (16.7%). No differences in other safety outcomes or adverse events were seen.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among children treated for septic shock, no significant difference was seen in the incidence of death, new renal-replacement therapy, or persistent kidney dysfunction when fluid resuscitation was administered with balanced fluid as compared with 0.9% saline. (Funded by Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and others; PRoMPT BOLUS ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04102371.).

articles.title: Primary care quality and secondary healthcare utilisation in patients with multimorbidity: a retrospective cohort study
articles.authors: Gao Q, Hayhoe BW, Cicek M, Greenfield G, Otis M, Misirli G, Neves AL, Majeed A, et al.

abstract.text: Background High-quality primary care can improve multimorbidity management but little evidence is available to understand its impact on secondary care use over time. Aim To assess the concurrent and lagged associations between quality of primary care and planned and unplanned secondary care use, examining the modifying role of frailty. Design and Setting A retrospective cohort study included 468,172 patients with multimorbidity in England from the Discover research platform (April 2022-March 2024). Method We used principal component analysis to combine a set of quality indicators (QIs) and assessed the impacts of QIs on both planned and unplanned care using regression models. Results Generally, patients with higher QI attainment also had higher likelihood of outpatient visits, emergency admissions and ED visits. There was a lower lagged odds of elective hospital admissions in the following 12 months among those with higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs. In the complex multimorbidity cohort (≥3 conditions), multimorbidity-specific QIs were longitudinally associated with lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, while generic QIs were related to lower odds of outpatient non-attendance. Conclusion Attainment of generic and multimorbidity QIs was generally associated with slightly increased planned and unplanned care. However, patients for whom we identified higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs had lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, especially for those with complex multimorbidity. Our research suggests that the quality of primary care may influence patients' use of secondary care, with the potential to improve care for people with multimorbidity and warrant further investigation into management strategies.

articles.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Effectiveness and Safety for the 2026-2027 Respiratory Season
articles.authors: Lipson RA, Senerth E, Watson MA, Saini H, Falk J, Tangri N, Sheikholeslamian SM, Sivakumaran K, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: SARS-CoV-2 remains a substantial cause of respiratory illness, morbidity, and mortality. Evidence to date has demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccines reduce the risk of severe disease, including hospitalization and death.
abstract.textZh: SARS-CoV-2仍然是呼吸道疾病、發病率和死亡率的主要原因。迄今為止的證據表明， COVID-19疫苗可以降低嚴重疾病的風險，包括住院和死亡。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: This systematic review identifies and summarizes newly published studies reporting on the effectiveness and safety of COVID-19 vaccines and COVID-19 epidemiology in the US.
abstract.textZh: 這項系統綜述確定並總結了新發表的研究，這些研究報告了COVID-19疫苗和COVID-19流行病學在美國的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: EVIDENCE REVIEW
abstract.text: Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus were searched from August 1, 2025, through June 29, 2026. Studies were eligible if they reported on the effectiveness, efficacy, or safety of a US-licensed COVID-19 vaccine or SARS-CoV-2 epidemiology in the US.
abstract.textZh: 從2025年8月1日至2026年6月29日搜索了Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase和Scopus。如果研究報告了美國許可的COVID-19疫苗或SARS-CoV-2流行病學在美國的有效性、有效性或安全性，則符合資格。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From 11 829 identified references, 155 publications were eligible (15 randomized clinical trials, 84 observational studies with a comparator group, 38 product safety studies without a comparator group [single group], and 18 descriptive studies of disease burden). Consistent with prior evidence, studies reported that updated COVID-19 vaccines were associated with a reduction in the risk of hospitalization among both older adults (≥65 years; vaccine effectiveness [VE], 53.0%; 95% CI, 37.0%-65.0%; 2025-2026 season) and adults (18-64 years; VE, 54.0%; 95% CI, 1.0%-78.0%; 2024-2025 season). Maternal vaccination was associated with reduced risk of COVID-19-associated emergency department/urgent care encounters among individuals vaccinated (VE, 58.0%; 95% CI, 24.0%-77.0%) and with fewer COVID-19-related hospital contacts in the first 2 months of life among infants born subsequently (VE range, 50.0%-54.0%), regardless of trimester of vaccination. Vaccination was also associated with a significant reduction in COVID-19-related pediatric emergency department visits (9 months to 4 years; VE, 76.0%; 95% CI, 58.0%-87.0%). Vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of critical COVID-19 illness (intensive care unit admission or death) in immunocompromised adults (VE range, 32.0%-53.0%, depending on condition and other factors). Health care personnel who received 3 to 5 vaccine doses were less likely to develop laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 illness (VE, 41.0%; 95% CI, 34.0%-47.0%) and postacute COVID-19 symptoms (VE, 57.0%; 95% CI, 46.0%-66.0%) compared with those who received only 2 doses. Across adverse events of special interest (eg, stroke, thrombosis, myocarditis), safety profiles were consistent with those of previous reviews. No identified studies conducted under the updated guidance on extended dosing intervals for the primary series reported an increased risk of myocarditis or pericarditis. No new safety signals were reported in the recently published studies eligible for this updated review of US-licensed COVID-19 vaccines.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: COVID-19 vaccines were consistently associated with a reduction in the risk of hospitalization and other outcomes, including among individuals at high risk of severe COVID-19, such as infants, and those who were pregnant. No new safety concerns were identified.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Influenza continues to cause significant mortality and morbidity in the US. Seasonal influenza vaccines reduce the severity of disease and prevent hospitalizations and death, especially among individuals at high risk.
abstract.textZh: 流感繼續在美國造成顯著的死亡率和發病率。季節性流感疫苗可以降低疾病的嚴重程度，防止住院和死亡，特別是在高風險人羣中。

abstract.text: To identify and summarize the most recently published research spanning several influenza seasons reporting on the epidemiology of influenza in the US and the effectiveness and safety of US-licensed seasonal influenza vaccines, updating a prior evidence review through August 2025.

abstract.label: EVIDENCE REVIEW
abstract.text: This systematic review searched Medline (PubMed), Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Scopus from August 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026, for all English-language studies. Eligible publications reported on the epidemiology of influenza in the US or vaccine effectiveness and safety for any influenza vaccine formulation approved for use in the US. Data extraction included effectiveness and safety estimates reported among older adults; adults; during pregnancy; infants, children, and young adults; and persons who were immunocompromised. Risk of bias assessment was conducted.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: The search identified 69 eligible studies: 21 randomized clinical trials (RCTs) and 23 observational studies with a comparator group, 7 product safety studies without a comparator group, and 18 descriptive studies of disease burden. Across multiple seasons, influenza vaccines were associated with reduced risk of influenza-related hospitalization (vaccine effectiveness [VE] ranging from 19.0%; 95% CI, 0.0%-34.0% to 43.0%; 95% CI, 30.0%-53.0%) and mortality (VE ranging from 29.0%; 95% CI, 16.0%-40.0% to 65.8%; 95% CI, 54.6%-76.9%) among older adults. Vaccines were also associated with reduced risk of severe influenza among infants, children, adolescents, and young adults; a case-cohort analysis of national surveillance data over 8 seasons (2016-2020 and 2021-2025) among infants, children, and adolescents aged 6 months to 17 years reported that VE was 80.0% (95% CI, 75.0%-84.0%) against laboratory-confirmed influenza-associated deaths. Vaccination during pregnancy was associated with a VE against symptomatic disease in infants of 44.4% (95% CI, 31.4%-54.9%) based on a retrospective cohort study from 2011 to 2022. Another self-controlled case series reported no association with increased risk of febrile seizure during the interval 0 to 7 days after vaccination.

No new safety concerns were identified.

articles.title: RSV Immunization Effectiveness and Safety for the 2026-2027 Respiratory Season
articles.authors: Senerth E, Sheikholeslamian SM, Babatunde I, Falk J, Watson MA, Saini H, Tangri N, Lipson RA, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute respiratory tract infection and a contributor to morbidity and mortality.
abstract.textZh: 呼吸道合胞病毒（ RSV ）是急性呼吸道感染的主要原因，也是發病率和死亡率的促成因素。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To synthesize evidence from recent randomized clinical trials and observational studies reporting on the effectiveness and safety of RSV vaccines and monoclonal antibodies and the epidemiology of RSV in the US.
abstract.textZh: 從最近的隨機臨牀試驗和觀察性研究中綜合證據，報告RSV疫苗和單株抗體的有效性和安全性以及RSV在美國的流行病學。

abstract.label: EVIDENCE REVIEW
abstract.text: Databases including MEDLINE (PubMed), Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Scopus were searched from August 1, 2025, through June 29, 2026, for studies evaluating the safety and effectiveness of US-licensed RSV vaccines or RSV monoclonal antibody products or describing RSV epidemiology. Data were extracted for older adults (≥60 years), adults, immunocompromised persons, infants, children, and individuals vaccinated during pregnancy. Reviewers assessed risk of bias (RoB) using Cochrane tools for randomized and observational studies.
abstract.textZh: 從2025年8月1日至2026年6月29日，搜尋了MEDLINE (PubMed)、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL和Scopus等資料庫，以評估美國許可的RSV疫苗或RSV單株抗體產品的安全性和有效性，或描述RSV流行病學。提取了老年人（ ≥ 60歲）、成人、免疫力低下者、嬰兒、兒童和懷孕期間接種疫苗的個體的數據。審查者使用Cochrane工具評估隨機和觀察性研究的偏倚風險(RoB)。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: A total of 75 eligible studies were identified, including 12 randomized clinical trials (RCTs), 33 observational studies with a comparator group, 16 observational studies without a comparator group, and 14 descriptive studies on RSV epidemiology. Among older adults, RSV vaccination was associated with a reduction in RSV-related hospitalization (vaccine effectiveness [VE], 83.3%; 95% CI, 42.9% to 96.9%). Point estimates for RSV VE against hospitalization and laboratory-confirmed RSV illness among older adults were significantly higher during the first season after vaccination compared with 12 to 18 months of follow-up in 1 study, although the difference was not significant when comparing VE after 1 season vs 2 seasons in another study. The VE for maternal vaccination (between 32-36 weeks' gestation) ranged from 51.0% (95% CI, -29.6% to 83.3%) to 70.0% (95% CI, 37.0% to 86.0%) against RSV-related infant hospitalization. Estimates for effectiveness of nirsevimab among infants varied by timing ranged from 63.6% (95% CI, 26.9% to 81.9%) to 93.0% (95% CI, 83.0% to 97.0%) for RSV-related hospitalization within 6 to 12 months. No cases of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) were identified across 3 RCTs; among older adults, 1 self-controlled case series reported a possible increased risk of GBS during the 42 days following vaccination. None of the comparative studies included in this review found an association of RSV vaccination during pregnancy with preterm birth or other adverse pregnancy outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 共確定了75項符合資格的研究，包括12項隨機臨牀試驗（ RCT ）、33項具有對照組的觀察性研究、16項沒有對照組的觀察性研究和14項RSV流行病學描述性研究。 在老年人中， RSV疫苗接種與RSV相關住院率降低有關（疫苗有效性[VE] ， 83.3% ； 95% CI ， 42.9%至96.9% ）。 在疫苗接種後的第一個季節，老年人RSV VE對住院和實驗室確認的RSV疾病的點數估計顯著高於1項研究中12至18個月的隨訪，儘管在1個季節後與另一項研究中比較VE與2個季節後的差異並不顯著。 對於RSV相關的嬰兒住院，母體疫苗接種（懷孕32-36週）的VE範圍從51.0% （ 95% CI ， -29.6%至83.3% ）到70.0% （ 95% CI ， 37.0%至86.0% ）不等。 對於6至12個月內RSV相關住院治療， nirsevimab在嬰兒中的有效性估計範圍從63.6% （ 95% CI ， 26.9%至81.9% ）到93.0% （ 95% CI ， 83.0%至97.0% ）不等。 在3個RCT中未發現格林-巴利綜合徵（ GBS ）病例；在老年人中， 1個自我對照病例系列報告接種疫苗後42天內GBS風險可能增加。 本綜述中包含的比較研究均未發現懷孕期間接種RSV疫苗與早產或其他不良

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: RSV immunizations were associated with reduced risk of severe RSV and RSV-related hospitalizations; evidence among older adults suggests that RSV VE may be lower in subsequent seasons. Reported adverse events of special interest (including GBS and preterm birth) were consistent with prior reviews. The results of this updated review are both consistent with previously reported evidence and provide new insight into several aspects of RSV immunizations.
abstract.textZh: RSV疫苗接種與嚴重RSV和RSV相關住院風險降低有關；老年人的證據表明， RSV VE在隨後的季節可能較低。報告的特別感興趣的不良事件（包括GBS和早產）與先前的審查一致。這項更新審查的結果既與先前報告的證據一致，又為RSV免疫接種的幾個方面提供了新的見解。

articles.title: Periconception Parental Red Blood Cell Folate, Vitamin B12, and Birth Defects in Offspring : A Prospective Cohort Study
articles.authors: Chen H, Chen X, Zhang Y, Li M, Yao Q, Wang D, Zhao Q, Peng Y, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maternal folic acid prevents neural tube defects, but associations of parental folate and vitamin B12 with birth defects remain unclear.
abstract.textZh: 母體葉酸可預防神經管缺陷，但母體葉酸和維生素B12與出生缺陷的關聯仍不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To quantify associations of parental vitamin B12 and red blood cell (RBC) folate with offspring birth defects.
abstract.textZh: 量化父母維生素B12和紅細胞（ RBC ）葉酸與後代出生缺陷的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Shanghai Preconception Cohort, China.
abstract.textZh: 中國上海Preconception Cohort。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 3032 couples (73 birth defect cases) with biomarkers sampled within 4 months before conception, and 17 765 women (327 birth defect cases) sampled at 4 months' gestation or earlier.
abstract.textZh: 3032對夫婦（ 73例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕前4個月內取樣， 17 765名婦女（ 327例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕4個月或更早時取樣。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Standardized predicted prevalences of birth defects ascertained among live births, stillbirths, and abortions due to fetal abnormalities were estimated using weighted logistic regression.
abstract.textZh: 使用加權邏輯迴歸估計活產、死產和胎兒異常墮胎之間確定的出生缺陷的標準化預測患病率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher preconception parental levels of vitamin B12 were associated with lower predicted prevalences of birth defects in dose-response analyses. For preconception maternal vitamin B12 from the lowest (<148 pmol/L) to highest (≥590 pmol/L) categories, predicted prevalence decreased from 49.6 to 16.2 cases per 1000 pregnancies; paternal vitamin B12 showed a similar but attenuated pattern (55.5 to 24.0 cases per 1000 pregnancies). Preconception parental RBC folate showed imprecise patterns of lower predicted prevalence. For postconception maternal RBC folate, predicted prevalence was lower at levels of 906 to 1131 nmol/L than at levels below 453 nmol/L (16.5 vs. 25.7 cases per 1000 pregnancies), with little further reduction at higher levels. For postconception maternal vitamin B12, predicted prevalence changed little across lower categories but was lower at higher levels (11.8 vs. 20.4 cases per 1000 pregnancies at ≥590 vs. 148 to 294 pmol/L, respectively).
abstract.textZh: 在劑量反應分析中，父母對維生素B12的偏好程度較高，與出生缺陷的預測患病率較低有關。對於孕前母體維生素B12 ，從最低（ < 148 pmol/L ）到最高（ ≥ 590 pmol/L ）類別，預測患病率從每1000例懷孕49.6例降至16.2例；父體維生素B12顯示出類似但減弱的模式（每1000例懷孕55.5至24.0例）。受孕前父母紅細胞葉酸顯示出較低預測患病率的不精確模式。對於受孕後母體紅細胞葉酸， 906至1131 nmol/L水平的預測患病率低於453 nmol/L以下的水平（每1000例懷孕中有16.5例與25.7例） ，在更高水平上幾乎沒有進一步降低。對於受孕後的母體維生素B12 ，預測的患病率在較低類別中變化不大，但在較高水平時則較低（分別為11.8例和20.4例，每1000例懷孕，分別為≥ 590例和148至294 pmol/L ）。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Residual confounding.
abstract.textZh: 剩餘的混淆。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Periconception parental vitamin B12 and postconception maternal RBC folate were associated with lower predicted prevalences of birth defects.
abstract.textZh: 受孕期父母維生素B12和受孕後母體紅細胞葉酸與出生缺陷的預測患病率較低有關。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: National Key Research and Development Program of China, National Natural Science Foundation of China, and Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences.
abstract.textZh: 中國國家重點研發計劃、中國國家自然科學基金會、中國醫學科學院。

articles.title: Ethics and Professionalism in Artificial Intelligence and Medical Practice: A Position Paper From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: DeCamp M, Snyder Sulmasy L, Karches KE, Ethics, Professionalism and Human Rights Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) in health care is being rapidly adopted in perhaps one of the most rapid implementations of technology in medicine to date. Better thought of as augmented intelligence, as a tool that provides assistance to physicians and patients, many guidelines for its use have been issued, but consensus has not yet been achieved on issues such as privacy, disclosure, and fairness. Patients and physicians need ethical guidance at the point of care. Three guideposts described in this American College of Physicians position paper and rooted in the patient-physician relationship-principles of medical ethics, clinical integrity, and physician-independent practical reasoning-can inform the ethical use of AI: relationality, self-governance, and competence. This paper examines the implications of AI for patients, physicians, and health care and provides guidance for its ethical use.
abstract.textZh: 醫療保健中的人工智能（ AI ）正在被迅速採用，可能是迄今為止醫學中最快速的技術實施之一。更好地將其視為增強智能，作為為為醫生和患者提供幫助的工具，已經發布了許多使用指南，但在隱私，披露和公平性等問題上尚未達成共識。患者和醫生在護理時需要道德指導。這份美國醫師學會立場文件中描述並植根於病人與醫師關係的三個指南-醫學倫理原則，臨牀誠信和醫師獨立的實踐推理-可以為AI的倫理使用提供信息：關係性，自我治理和能力。本文研究AI對患者、醫生和醫療保健的影響，並為其道德使用提供指導。

articles.titleZh: 人工智能與醫療實踐中的倫理與專業：美國醫師學院的立場論文

articles.title: Efficacy and Safety of Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Co-agonists for Weight Loss Among Adults Without Diabetes : An Updated Systematic Review
articles.authors: Moiz A, Filion KB, Samuels AE, Tsoukas MA, Yu OHY, Peters TM, Eisenberg MJ

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are increasingly used for weight management.
abstract.textZh: 胰高血糖素樣肽-1受體激動劑（ GLP-1 RA ）越來越多地用於體重管理。

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To update our prior systematic review evaluating the efficacy and safety of GLP-1 RAs and co-agonists among adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes.
abstract.textZh: 更新我們先前的系統審查，評估GLP-1類風濕性關節炎和共受體在沒有糖尿病的超重或肥胖成人中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials from 5 October 2024 through 25 March 2026.
abstract.textZh: 2024年10月5日至2026年3月25日期間的MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane中央對照試驗登記冊。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Randomized controlled trials ([RCTs] treatment duration ≥16 weeks).
abstract.textZh: 隨機對照試驗（ [RCT]治療持續時間≥ 16週）。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Two reviewers independently extracted data.
abstract.textZh: 兩位審核人員獨立擷取資料。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Thirty-eight RCTs (n = 25 816) were included, adding 14 new trials (n = 11 000) to the prior review. Among commercially available therapies, placebo-subtracted weight loss reached up to -5.8% (95% CI, -8.0% to -3.6%) for liraglutide, -14.8% (CI, -16.2% to -13.4%) for subcutaneous semaglutide, -14.3% (CI, -17.2% to -11.4%) for oral semaglutide, -12.4% (CI, -15.1% to -9.7%) for orforglipron, and -19.0% (CI, -21.6% to -16.4%) for tirzepatide. Numerically greater placebo-subtracted reductions were seen with emerging multiagonists, including -23.9% (CI, -29.3% to -18.5%) with amycretin and -22.1% (CI, -24.9% to -19.3%) with retatrutide. Gastrointestinal adverse events (AEs) remained common (GLP-1 RA vs. placebo: 76.0% vs. 40.1%). Discontinuation due to AEs was generally low (10.7% vs. 3.4%) but numerically higher with some oral agents. Serious AEs (6.5% vs. 5.2%) and deaths (0.1% vs. 0.0%) were rare, with no new safety signals identified. Head-to-head data showed greater weight loss with semaglutide and JNJ-64565111 than liraglutide and greater weight loss with tirzepatide and cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema; Novo Nordisk) than semaglutide.
abstract.textZh: 納入了38項RCT （ n = 25 816 ） ，在先前的審查中增加了14項新試驗（ n = 11 000 ）。 在市售療法中，利拉魯肽的安慰劑減重達到-5.8 ％ （ 95 ％ CI ， -8.0 ％至-3.6 ％ ） ，皮下semaglutide達到-14.8 ％ （ CI ， -16.2 ％至-13.4 ％ ） ，口服semaglutide達到-14.3 ％ （ CI ， -17.2 ％至-11.4 ％ ） ， orforglipron達到-12.4 ％ （ CI ， -15.1 ％至-9.7 ％ ） ， tirzepatide達到-19.0 ％ （ CI ， -21.6 ％至-16.4 ％ ）。 新興多受體藥物的安慰劑減量數值較大，包括阿米屈丁的-23.9% （信賴區間， -29.3%至-18.5% ）和瑞他曲肽的-22.1% （信賴區間， -24.9%至-19.3% ）。 胃腸道不良事件（ AE ）仍然很常見（ GLP-1 RA對比安慰劑： 76.0%對40.1% ）。 由於不良事件導致的停藥率通常較低（ 10.7%對3.4% ） ，但某些口服藥物的停藥率較高。 嚴重不良事件（ 6.5%對5.2% ）和死亡（ 0.1%對0.0% ）很少見，沒有發現新的安全性信號。 頭對頭數據顯示，與利拉魯肽相比， semaglutide和JNJ-64565111的減肥效果更好，與semaglutide相比， tirzepatide和cagrilintide-semaglutide （ CagriSema ； Novo Nordisk ）的減肥效果更好。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Heterogeneity precluded quantitative synthesis. Safety outcomes were inconsistently reported.
abstract.textZh: 異質性排除了定量合成。報告的安全結果不一致。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists demonstrate substantial weight loss in adults without diabetes, with an expanding range of therapeutic options, including oral and multiagonist therapies.
abstract.textZh: 胰高血糖素樣肽-1受體激動劑在沒有糖尿病的成年人中表現出顯著的體重減輕，具有擴大的治療選擇範圍，包括口服和多受體激動劑治療。

abstract.text: None. (PROSPERO: CRD42024505558).
abstract.textZh: 無。（ PROSPERO ： CRD42024505558 ）。

articles.title: Understanding Suicide through Coroners' Narratives: implications for primary care from a mixed‑methods study of 157 Coroners' reports
articles.authors: Oliver P, Reed E, Hulin J, Delaney B, Marshall J, Mitchell C

abstract.text: Suicide is a major public health concern, and general practice is often a recent point of contact before death. While mental illness is well recognised, the broader social and contextual factors influencing suicide risk remain under-reported in primary care and epidemiological research Aim To describe the demographic, clinical, and psychosocial characteristics of individuals who died by suicide, integrating coronial quantitative data with qualitative narrative accounts to identify implications for primary/ secondary care and public health. Design and setting Explanatory sequential mixed‑methods study of 157 consecutive deaths by suicide recorded by coroners (2018-19) across five English local authorities. Method Demographic, clinical, and social data were extracted from coroners' records and summarised descriptively. Narrative case summaries were coded and analysed thematically to identify contextual, relational, and service factors preceding death. Results Of 157 individuals: 79% were male; 65% lived in the most deprived IMD quintile; 85% had a diagnosed mental health condition; 62% had a long‑term physical illness; 41% had a previous suicide attempt. About half consulted a GP in the preceding three months; mental health featured in about half of those consultations. Common stressors were relationship breakdown (37.2%), housing instability (22.1%), and work pressures (18.2%). Seven interlinked themes were identified: Mental health; Alcohol/Substance use, Physical health; Social connectedness; Life course trauma, Socioeconomic and Structural Vulnerability; Healthcare access. Service transitions were key vulnerability points Conclusion Coroners' records offer important insights into the complex circumstances preceding suicide and highlight opportunities for GPs to recognise intersectional complexity and support integrated, cross-sector suicide prevention approaches.

articles.title: Learning disability register enrolment in young people in England: a cohort study using primary care data
articles.authors: Shah R, Horridge K, Saxena S, Hargreaves DS, Petersen I

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Learning disability registers in UK primary care support proactive care, but under-identification remains substantial. The 2019 NHS Long Term Plan introduced targets to increase enrolment.
abstract.textZh: 學習障礙在英國初級保健支持主動式護理中註冊，但識別不足的情況仍然很嚴重。2019年NHS長期計劃引入了提高入學率的目標。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate prevalence and rates of new registration to learning disability registers among young people aged 14-24 years in England and examine changes following the introduction of national targets.
abstract.textZh: 估計英格蘭14-24歲年輕人中學習障礙登記的患病率和新登記率，並研究引入國家目標後的變化。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based open cohort study using routinely collected primary care data from general practices in England contributing to the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum database, 2015-2023.
abstract.textZh: 基於人羣的開放隊列研究，使用從英格蘭的一般實踐中定期收集的初級保健數據，有助於臨牀實踐研究數據鏈接Aurum數據庫， 2015-2023。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Young people aged 14-24 years who had been registered ≥6 months were included. Annual rates of new registration per 10 000 person-years at risk (PYAR) and recorded prevalence were calculated, stratified by age, sex, region, and year.
abstract.textZh: 已登記≥ 6個月的14-24歲年輕人也包括在內。按年齡、性別、地區和年份分層計算每10,000人年新登記率（ PYAR ）和記錄患病率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Between 2015 and 2023, 11 776 young people were first recorded on a learning disability register. Rates of new registration increased in 2020-2021 across ages and sexes, peaking at 15.8 per 10 000 PYAR in males aged 14-17 years and 8.4 per 10 000 in females before returning to pre-2019 levels by 2023. Recorded prevalence remained low overall (0.03-0.5%; 3.6-52.7 per 10 000) but increased among those aged 18-24 years, with eight-to-10-fold rises between 2015 and 2023. Prevalence was higher in males (rate ratios 1.7-1.8, 95% confidence interval = 1.6 to 1.9).
abstract.textZh: 在2015年至2023年期間，有11,776名年輕人首次登記在學習障礙登記冊上。2020-2021年，不同年齡和性別的新註冊率有所增加，在2023年之前恢復到2019年之前的水平之前， 14-17歲男性的新註冊率高達每10 000 PYAR 15.8 ，女性為每10 000 PYAR 8.4。記錄的總體患病率仍然很低（ 0.03-0.5 ％ ；每萬人3.6-52.7 ） ，但在18-24歲的人羣中增加， 2015年至2023年間增加了8至10倍。男性的患病率較高（比率比為1.7-1.8 ， 95%置信區間= 1.6-1.9 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: National targets coincided with a temporary rise in enrolment, but identification remains below expected prevalence. Sustained policy focus and systematic identification and coding by practices are needed to ensure equitable access to preventive care during the transition to adulthood.
abstract.textZh: 國家目標與入學率暫時上升相吻合，但識別率仍低於預期流行率。需要持續的政策重點以及按實踐進行系統識別和編碼，以確保在向成年過渡期間公平獲得預防性護理。

articles.titleZh: 英格蘭年輕人的學習障礙登記入學率：使用初級保健數據的隊列研究

articles.title: Disparities in the uptake of learning disability annual health checks: a secondary analysis of primary care data
articles.authors: Sutherland D, Costello B, Chauhan U, Flynn S, Gray KM, Parsons J, Spencer R, Crawford H

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: People with intellectual disabilities (referred to as learning disabilities in the UK) face considerable health inequalities. One attempt to address these in England has been through incentivising general practices to complete annual health checks with people with a learning disability aged ≥14 years.
abstract.textZh: 智障人士（英國稱為學習障礙）面臨相當大的健康不平等。在英格蘭，解決這些問題的一個嘗試是通過激勵一般做法，對年齡大於或等於14歲的學習障礙者完成年度健康檢查。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine recent trends in learning disability registers and the uptake of learning disability annual health checks in England.
abstract.textZh: 檢查英格蘭學習障礙登記的近期趨勢和學習障礙年度健康檢查的採用情況。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Secondary analysis of publicly available general practice data.
abstract.textZh: 公開一般實踐資料的次要分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: NHS England data relating to the learning disabilities annual health check scheme from January 2022 to November 2025 were compiled and analysed.
abstract.textZh: 我們彙編並分析了英國國民保健署（ NHS ）在2022年1月至2025年11月期間與學習障礙年度健康檢查計劃相關的數據。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The number of 14-17-year-olds and adults on learning disability registers increased during this period by 30.49% and 14.53%, respectively. The most recent estimates indicate that around 0.588% (n = 374 763/63 766 671) of patients are on learning disability registers, with approximately 0.526% (n = 355 102/63 654 156) aged ≥14 years and eligible for annual health checks. The uptake of annual health checks increased slightly from 68.08% (n = 15 940/23 414) to 71.58% (n = 19 217/26 846) among 14-17-year-olds, and from 79.07% (n = 226 701/286 714) to 80.71% (n = 248 449/307 827) among adults. Uptake was lowest in the South West and East of England, and highest in London, but was similar across deciles of patient deprivation and practice size.
abstract.textZh: 在此期間，學習障礙登記冊上的14-17歲和成人人數分別增加了30.49%和14.53%。最近的估計表明，約有0.588 ％ （ n = 374 763/63 766 671 ）的患者在學習障礙登記冊上，約有0.526 ％ （ n = 355 102/63 654 156 ）年齡≥ 14歲，有資格進行年度健康檢查。14-17歲兒童接受年度健康檢查的比例從68.08% （ n = 15 940/23 414 ）略微增加到71.58% （ n = 19 217/26 846 ） ，成年人從79.07% （ n = 226 701/286 714 ）增加到80.71% （ n = 248 449/307 827 ）。攝取量在英格蘭西南部和東部最低，在倫敦最高，但在患者剝奪和實踐規模方面相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Ascertainment of people with a learning disability by primary care services appears to be improving but remains between one-third and one-quarter of prevalence estimates. The uptake of annual health checks among 14-17-year-olds continues to lag behind that of adults.
abstract.textZh: 初級護理服務對學習障礙人士的確定似乎正在改善，但仍在估計患病率的三分之一至四分之一之間。14-17歲的年度健康檢查率繼續落後於成年人。

articles.titleZh: 學習障礙年度健康檢查採用方面的差異：初級保健數據的次要分析

articles.title: Relationships of actual and expected levels of income with GP job satisfaction: repeated cross-sectional study
articles.authors: Walker B, Anderson M, Ganepola R, Hutchinson J, Gibson J, Urwin S, Checkland K, Sutton M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Income is known to be a key driver of job satisfaction, especially when compared with expected income. The pertinence of this for GPs is not fully understood.
abstract.textZh: 眾所周知，收入是工作滿意度的關鍵驅動因素，尤其是與預期收入相比。這與全科醫生的相關性尚不完全清楚。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine whether GP job satisfaction and intentions to quit are affected by actual and expected levels of income.
abstract.textZh: 檢查全科醫生的工作滿意度和辭職意圖是否受到實際和預期收入水平的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN & SETTING
abstract.text: Repeated cross-sectional study involving GPs in England. The authors analysed responses to four waves of the GP Worklife Survey (a survey of GPs in England), between 2015 and 2021.
abstract.textZh: 在英格蘭重複進行涉及全科醫生的橫斷面研究。作者分析了2015年至2021年間對四波全科醫生工作生活調查（英格蘭全科醫生調查）的回應。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Linear regression models were used to examine the associations of actual income with 10 domains of job satisfaction and three aspects of intentions to quit, adjusted for potential confounders; responders' self-reported expected incomes were then added to these models. These analyses were repeated, stratifying by contract status and age.
abstract.textZh: 使用線性迴歸模型來檢查實際收入與10個工作滿意度領域和三個辭職意圖方面的關聯，並針對潛在的混雜因素進行調整；然後將回應者自我報告的預期收入添加到這些模型中。重複這些分析，按合約狀態和年齡分層。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher actual income had a statistically significant association with increased satisfaction across most job satisfaction domains except for 'Amount of variety in your job', 'Your colleagues and fellow workers', and 'Physical working conditions'. There was little evidence of a relationship between actual income and intentions to quit. Higher expected income, conditional on actual income, had a statistically significant association with reduced job satisfaction across all domains and increased intentions to quit. The relationship between expected income and intentions to work abroad in the next 5 years was stronger for GPs aged <40 years, and the relationship between actual income and job satisfaction was stronger for GP partners and for GPs aged >50 years.
abstract.textZh: 除了「您工作的多樣性」、「您的同事和同事」和「實際工作條件」之外，實際收入越高，大多數工作滿意度領域的滿意度就越高。實際收入與辭職意圖之間的關係幾乎沒有證據。以實際收入為條件的較高預期收入與所有領域的工作滿意度降低和辭職意向增加有著統計學上的顯著關聯。對於年齡< 40歲的全科醫生，未來5年預期收入與出國工作意願之間的關係更強，而對於全科醫生合作夥伴和年齡> 50歲的全科醫生，實際收入與工作滿意度之間的關係更強。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Higher incomes were associated with higher job satisfaction, but lower than expected levels of income were important sources of dissatisfaction and intentions to quit.
abstract.textZh: 較高的收入與較高的工作滿意度有關，但低於預期的收入水平是不滿意和辭職意圖的重要來源。

articles.titleZh: 實際和預期收入水平與GP工作滿意度的關係：重複橫斷面研究

articles.title: Investigating the conditions in which women GPs thrive in general practice: a realist review
articles.authors: Abrams R, Williams V, Park S, Golder S, Goyal A, Whiley L, Jefferson L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women GPs experience higher rates of burnout, anxiety, depression, and slower career progression than men GPs. Women GPs are sought out by patients for specific conditions, which may increase consultation length. This can be a source of job satisfaction for some. However, it can also contribute to additional exhaustion and affects career progression, meaning women GPs are at higher risk of leaving the profession. There is an urgent need to identify solutions to retain and support them.
abstract.textZh: 與男性全科醫生相比，女性全科醫生的職業倦怠、焦慮、抑鬱和職業發展緩慢率更高。患者會針對特定情況尋求女性全科醫生，這可能會增加會診時間。對某些人來說，這可能是工作滿意度的來源。然而，它也可能導致額外的疲憊並影響職業發展，這意味著女性全科醫生離開職業的風險更高。迫切需要確定留住和支持他們的解決方案。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: This review brings together a wide range of evidence to identify the conditions in which women GPs can thrive, to better support them at work.
abstract.textZh: 這項審查匯集了廣泛的證據，以確定女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件，以便在工作中更好地支持她們。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: An international realist review of academic and grey literature was conducted across eight databases and Google Scholar.
abstract.textZh: 在八個資料庫和Google學術搜尋中，對學術文獻和灰色文獻進行了國際現實主義審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Following a realist approach, supported by stakeholder and patient involvement, a range of published documents were analysed using a realist logic to identify how, why, for whom, and in what circumstances women GPs thrive at work.
abstract.textZh: 在利益相關者和患者參與的支持下，遵循現實主義的方法，使用現實主義邏輯分析了一系列已發佈的文件，以確定女性全科醫生如何、為什麼、為誰以及在什麼情況下在工作中茁壯成長。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 72 documents are included in this review. Sixteen configurations describe the conditions in which women GPs can thrive. Results cover the following three concepts: patient-facing work; navigating competing roles; and sustainable careers, leadership, and success. However, literature also places heavy reliance on encouraging women GPs to 'fix' their own circumstances.
abstract.textZh: 本次審核共包含72份文件。十六種配置描述了女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件。結果涵蓋以下三個概念：面向患者的工作；導航相互競爭的角色；以及可持續的職業生涯、領導力和成功。然而，文獻也嚴重依賴鼓勵女性全科醫生「修復」自己的情況。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This review provides evidence-based recommendations that may be of interest to those responsible for organisational culture within general practices, including (but not limited to) GP partners, and women GPs, who can utilise the recommendations to influence change.
abstract.textZh: 本審查提供以證據為基礎的建議，這些建議可能對一般實踐中負責組織文化的人員感興趣，包括（但不限於）全科醫生合作夥伴和女性全科醫生，他們可以利用這些建議來影響變革。

articles.titleZh: 調查女性全科醫生在一般診所中茁壯成長的條件：現實主義審查

articles.title: GP survivors' experiences working with family violence survivors: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Neil J, Delany C, McLindon E, Hegarty K

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Domestic and family violence (DFV) is common worldwide and GPs are not immune. DFV survivors frequently present to primary care where GP DFV survivors often encounter them. Little literature and no qualitative studies, to the authors' knowledge, have looked at the emotional and professional effects that these encounters have on survivor GPs, including how it affects their ability to care for survivor patients.
abstract.textZh: 家庭暴力（ DFV ）在世界各地都很常見，全科醫生也不能幸免。DFV倖存者經常出現在GP DFV倖存者經常遇到他們的初級保健中。據作者所知，很少有文獻和沒有定性研究研究了這些遭遇對倖存者全科醫生產生的情感和專業影響，包括它如何影響他們照顧倖存者患者的能力。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To answer the question: what are the experiences of survivor GPs when working with patient survivors of DFV?
abstract.textZh: 回答這個問題：倖存者全科醫生在與DFV患者倖存者合作時的經歷是什麼？

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A phenomenological qualitative study, to gain a deep understanding of Australian GP DFV survivors' experiences when working with survivor patients.
abstract.textZh: 一項現象學定性研究，深入了解澳大利亞GP DFV倖存者在與倖存者患者合作時的經歷。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Participants were Australian GPs self-identifying as survivors of all forms of DFV. Participants were recruited from two Australian GP online groups using purposive sampling. Semi-structured interviews took place and were audio-recorded and transcribed verbatim. Reflexive thematic analysis was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 參與者是自我識別為所有形式DFV倖存者的澳大利亞全科醫生。參與者是使用有目的的抽樣從兩個澳大利亞全科醫生網上團體中招募的。進行了半結構化的訪談，並進行了錄音和逐字轉錄。進行反射性主題分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants (n = 20) were women and worked in a range of locations throughout Australia. Four themes were identified: 'my experiences can be my superpower' (encompassing the subthemes: 'having a sixth sense' and 'going above and beyond'); 'connecting with survivors' stories'; 'wearing a cloak'; and 'my experiences give me a sense of purpose'.
abstract.textZh: 參與者（ n = 20 ）為女性，在澳大利亞各地工作。確定了四個主題： “我的經歷可以成為我的超能力” （包括子主題： “擁有第六感”和“超越” ）; “與倖存者的故事聯繫”; “穿著鬥篷”;和“我的經歷給我一種目的感”。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Although GP DFV survivors commonly experienced difficult emotions when working with survivor patients they had a commitment to this work that stemmed from personal DFV experiences. This increased their empathy for survivors and gave them a deep understanding of their circumstances, allowing them to work powerfully with survivors, aiming to improve their situation.
abstract.textZh: 雖然GP DFV倖存者在與倖存者患者合作時通常會經歷困難的情緒，但他們對這項工作的承諾源於個人的DFV經歷。這增加了他們對倖存者的同理心，並讓他們深入了解自己的情況，使他們能夠與倖存者強有力地合作，旨在改善他們的處境。

articles.titleZh: 全科醫生倖存者與家庭暴力倖存者合作的經驗：定性研究

articles.title: Association of the NHS Health Check with all-cause mortality: a longitudinal cohort study in primary care
articles.authors: Saund J, Dodhia H, Vanoli J, Masselot P, O'Neill S

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention is a policy priority because of widening inequalities and increasing preventable deaths. The NHS Health Check (NHS-HC) programme aims to promote early detection and prevention of CVD but has a wider-reaching impact owing to targeting multiple risk factors. Although programme evaluations demonstrate improvements in detection and surrogate markers, research on mortality outcomes remain limited, particularly using representative, real-world data.
abstract.textZh: 由於不平等擴大和可預防的死亡人數增加，心血管疾病（ CVD ）預防是政策優先事項。NHS健康檢查（ NHS-HC ）計劃旨在促進CVD的早期發現和預防，但由於針對多種風險因素，具有更廣泛的影響。儘管計劃評估顯示檢測和替代標記有所改善，但對死亡率結果的研究仍然有限，特別是使用具有代表性的真實世界數據。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate the effectiveness of NHS-HCs in reducing all-cause mortality.
abstract.textZh: 評估NHS-HCs在降低全因死亡率方面的有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Longitudinal cohort study in an inner-city London borough.
abstract.textZh: 倫敦內城區的縱向隊列研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data from electronic primary care records were analysed for 158 645 eligible participants (2009-2023). Survival was modelled using a Cox proportional hazards model with time-varying exposure. All-cause mortality risk was compared between those attending ≥1 NHS-HC (n = 42 589) and those who did not (n = 116 056). Sociodemographic, geographic, and behavioural factors were adjusted using propensity score weighting.
abstract.textZh: 對158,645名合格參與者（ 2009-2023年）的電子初級護理記錄數據進行了分析。使用具有時變暴露的Cox比例風險模型對存活率進行建模。參加≥ 1 NHS-HC的患者（ n = 42 589 ）和未參加NHS-HC的患者（ n = 116 056 ）之間的全因死亡率風險進行了比較。使用傾向分數加權調整社會人口、地理和行為因素。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 158 645 participants, 63 347 (39.9%) were of Black, Asian, mixed, or other ethnicity, and 100 825 (63.6%) lived in the two most deprived quintiles in England. Attendance at ≥1 NHS-HC was associated with lower mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 0.68, 95% confidence interval = 0.63 to 0.74), indicating a 32% reduction in risk. Ten-year absolute mortality risk reduction increased with age, with the largest difference among those aged 70-74 years (18.1% versus 12.9%). Sensitivity analyses supported these findings.
abstract.textZh: 在158 645名參與者中， 63 347人（ 39.9% ）為黑人、亞裔、混血或其他種族， 100 825人（ 63.6% ）居住在英格蘭最貧困的兩個五分之一人口中。≥ 1 NHS-HC的出勤率與較低的死亡率有關（調整後的風險比為0.68 ， 95%置信區間= 0.63至0.74 ） ，表明風險降低了32%。10年絕對死亡率風險降低隨著年齡的增長而增加，其中70-74歲之間的差異最大（ 18.1 ％對12.9 ％ ）。敏感性分析支持這些發現。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study suggests significant long-term survival benefit associated with the NHS-HC, supporting continued investment in and optimisation of the programme to provide population health benefits. Findings were robust to missing data assumptions and COVID-19, although residual confounding cannot be ruled out.
abstract.textZh: 這項研究表明，與NHS-HC相關的顯著長期生存益處，支持對該計劃的持續投資和優化，以提供人羣健康益處。雖然不能排除遺漏數據假設和COVID-19的殘留混淆，但調查結果對於遺漏數據假設和COVID-19來說是強有力的。

articles.titleZh: NHS健康檢查與全因死亡率的關聯：初級保健的縱向隊列研究

articles.title: Exploring GPs' prioritisation dilemmas - 'quick wins' versus 'eating the frog': a qualitative study in primary care
articles.authors: McClarey A, Dunsmore A, McNab D, Smith SE

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Prioritisation is an increasing part of a GP's workload, although learning this skill is usually left to on-the-job training. Little is known about how experienced GPs prioritise their workload.
abstract.textZh: 優先順序是全科醫生工作負荷中不斷增加的一部分，儘管學習這項技能通常留給在職培訓。對於經驗豐富的全科醫生如何優先處理工作量，知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore the factors that experienced GPs consider when prioritising their acute workload.
abstract.textZh: 探索有經驗的全科醫生在優先考慮其急性工作量時所考慮的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This qualitative research study used focus groups of GP educators based in central Scotland to explore the factors that they consider when prioritising their acute workload.
abstract.textZh: 這項定性研究使用位於蘇格蘭中部的全科醫生教育工作者焦點小組，探討他們在優先考慮其急性工作量時所考慮的因素。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Participants were recruited through convenience sampling. The key inclusion criterion was being involved in the supervision of GP registrars. Five focus groups were carried out, and transcripts were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis to identify the dilemmas that GPs face when prioritising their workload.
abstract.textZh: 透過便利抽樣招募參與者。關鍵的納入標準是參與對全科醫生註冊機構的監督。進行五個焦點小組，並使用自反主題分析對成績單進行分析，以確定全科醫生在優先安排工作量時面臨的困境。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Thirty-nine participants took part. The following five themes emerged from the data: 1) system awareness and adapting to demand, whereby GPs maintain an awareness of their work system and adapt their consultation style to demand; 2) time management, which is where they make decisions in an order that manages their time efficiently; 3) familiarity with patients, which enables them to make quick decisions about patient care, although this can lead to bias in decision making; 4) relationships, whereby they rely on their therapeutic relationships with patients and working relationships with colleagues when making decisions; 5) personal preferences, which are important such as managing the simplest or the most complex presentations first.
abstract.textZh: 39名參與者參與了活動。從數據中得出以下五個主題： 1 ）系統意識和適應需求，即全科醫生保持對其工作系統的意識並根據需求調整其諮詢風格； 2 ）時間管理，即他們按照有效管理時間的順序做出決策； 3 ）熟悉患者，這使他們能夠就患者護理做出快速決定，儘管這可能導致決策偏見； 4 ）關係，即他們在做出決策時依靠與患者的治療關係和與同事的工作關係； 5 ）個人喜好，這很重要，例如首先管理最簡單或最複雜的演示。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Prioritisation is an increasingly important skill in modern general practice. It is crucial that those involved in prioritisation are given the time and tools necessary to adequately develop this skill.
abstract.textZh: 在現代一般實踐中，優先順序是越來越重要的技能。為參與優先順序排序的人員提供充分發展此技能所需的時間和工具至關重要。
