articles.title: Large Language Model versus Clinician Written Summaries of Research Papers
articles.authors: Guthmann R, Martin R, Lee E, Boisselle C

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Clinicians require concise, accurate summaries of new research to inform practice. Patient-Oriented Evidence that Matters (POEMs), published in American Family Physician, are a benchmark for summarizing primary literature in family medicine, while large language models (LLMs) offer scalable summarization but require rigorous evaluation. The objective of this study was to evaluate the accuracy and quality of summaries generated by large language models compared with expert-authored POEMs.
abstract.textZh: 臨牀醫生需要簡潔、準確的新研究摘要來為實踐提供信息。《美國家庭醫生》(American Family Physician)發表的以患者為導向的重要證據(POEM)是總結家庭醫學主要文獻的基準，而大型語言模型(LLM)則提供可擴展的總結，但需要嚴格的評估。本研究的目的是評估大型語言模型與專家撰寫的POEM產生的摘要的準確性和質量。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this study, we compared LLM-generated summaries (Microsoft Copilot, GPT-4o class) with 24 recent matched POEMs using a standardized prompt. Two trained raters independently scored each summary with a 13-item tool (score range 0-13), cataloged errors, recorded word counts, and indicated preferences on a 5-point scale.
abstract.textZh: 在這項研究中，我們使用標準化提示將LLM生成的摘要（ Microsoft Copilot ， GPT-4o類別）與24個最近匹配的POEM進行了比較。兩位受過訓練的評分者使用13項工具（分數範圍為0-13 ）獨立評分每個摘要、編目錯誤、記錄的字數，並以5分制表示偏好。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: LLM summaries outperformed POEMs in total score (mean 12.1 vs 10.6; mean difference 1.5, 95% CI 1.1-2.0; P < 0.001), with similar lengths (328 vs 353 words; P = 0.23). Errors occurred in fewer LLM-DOCSs (2/24) than POEMs (9/24), with a mean error score difference of 20% (95% CI 7% -33%; P < 0.001). POEMs most often missed in the categories Contextual Background and Limitations; both approaches frequently missed in Clinical Applicability. Reviewer preference favored LLM-DOCS (mean 2.44 on a 1-5 scale; 95% CI 2.1-2.8).
abstract.textZh: LLM總結在總分上優於POEM （平均12.1對10.6 ；平均差異1.5 ， 95% CI 1.1-2.0 ； P < 0.001 ） ，長度相似（ 328對353字； P = 0.23 ）。LLM-DOCS （ 2/24 ）的錯誤比POEM （ 9/24 ）少，平均錯誤分數差異為20% （ 95% CI 7% -33% ； P < 0.001 ）。上下文背景和局限性類別中最常遺漏的POEM ；臨牀適用性中經常遺漏這兩種方法。評論者偏好LLM-DOCS （ 1-5分的平均值為2.44 ； 95% CI 2.1-2.8 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An enterprise LLM, prompted in POEM style, produced accurate, low-error clinical summaries that matched or exceeded expert-edited POEMs and were generally preferred by reviewers, though further research is needed to assess broader applicability and impact. Findings support pragmatic LLM-assisted summarization and highlight the need for standardized evaluation tools and explicit prompts for clinical applicability.
abstract.textZh: 一個企業法學碩士，以詩歌風格提示，產生了準確、低誤差的臨牀摘要，與專家編輯的POEM相匹配或超過專家編輯的POEM ，並且通常是審稿人的首選，儘管還需要進一步的研究來評估更廣泛的適用性和影響。研究結果支持實用的LLM輔助總結，並強調需要標準化的評估工具和明確的臨牀適用性提示。

articles.titleZh: 大型語言模型與臨牀醫生撰寫的研究論文摘要

articles.title: The Impact of Biases for Early-Career Women in Medicine: "It's the Little Day-to-Day Microaggressions"
articles.authors: Byrd M, Filippi MK, Siddiqi A, Fleischer S, Bazemore A, Koempel A

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women physicians face multiple systemic and social biases in the clinical setting that erode mental and physical well-being. Gender-based discrimination was reported by 76% of early-career women physicians, decreasing to 57% for mid-career, and 36% for late-career. While these trends suggest that these biases may diminish with career progression, they remain a persistent burden of women physician's careers. This article offers a unique contribution by centering early-career women family physicians, a group underrepresented in qualitative research on workplace bias. This article focuses on participants' microaggressive experiences in the clinical setting to better understand the biases they face.
abstract.textZh: 女性醫生在臨牀環境中面臨多種系統性和社會性偏見，這些偏見會侵蝕身心健康。76 ％的早期職業女性醫生報告了基於性別的歧視，職業生涯中期降至57 ％ ，職業生涯晚期降至36 ％。雖然這些趨勢表明，這些偏見可能會隨著職業發展而減少，但它們仍然是女性醫生職業生涯的長期負擔。本文以職場偏見定性研究中代表性不足的早期職業女性家庭醫生為中心，提供了獨特的貢獻。本文著重於參與者在臨牀環境中的微攻擊體驗，以更好地了解他們面臨的偏見。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Via email we recruited 25 geographically and racially diverse early-career women physicians who responded to the 2021-2023 American Board of Family Medicine National Graduate Survey. A semi-structured interview guide was developed following a life-history approach to better understand the transitionary phase from residency to the practicing workforce. Interviews were transcribed verbatim, cleaned, and analyzed via Inductive Content Analysis in NVivo by qualitative researchers.
abstract.textZh: 透過電子郵件，我們招募了25位地理和種族多元化的早期職業女性醫生，她們回應了2021-2023年美國家庭醫學委員會全國研究生調查。根據生活史方法開發了半結構化面試指南，以更好地了解從住院醫生到實習勞動力的過渡階段。訪談由定性研究人員在NVivo中通過歸納內容分析逐字轉錄、清理和分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: We identified three main themes that emerged from the data. First, biased communications within the clinical setting exposed a pattern of gender bias. Second, patients invalidate physicians' positions based on appearance and perception. Third, women physicians described navigating the emotional and psychological labor of clinical and societal expectations.
abstract.textZh: 我們從數據中確定了三個主要主題。首先，臨牀環境中的偏見溝通暴露了性別偏見的模式。其次，患者根據外表和感知使醫生的立場無效。第三，女性醫生描述了導航臨牀和社會期望的情感和心理勞動。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: In the context of primary care, microaggressions demand direct and intentional intervention. Failing to address these experiences jeopardizes both equity and workforce sustainability. Leadership must be equipped to recognize, interrupt, and respond to microaggressions-not only to support individual clinicians but to strengthen organizational culture and the broader primary care mission. Interference reflects the broader societal imperative and commitment to equity in healthcare.
abstract.textZh: 在初級保健的背景下，微侵犯需要直接和故意的幹預。未能解決這些經驗會危及公平和勞動力可持續性。領導者必須具備識別、中斷和應對微侵略的能力-不僅要支持個別臨牀醫生，還要加強組織文化和更廣泛的初級保健使命。幹預反映了更廣泛的社會責任和對醫療保健公平的承諾。

articles.titleZh: 偏見對醫學界早期職業女性的影響：「這是小小的日常微侵犯」

articles.title: Catheter-Directed Thrombolysis in Intermediate-High-Risk Pulmonary Embolism
articles.authors: Kroupa J, Radvan M, Mrozek J, Sluka M, Jirous S, Hlinomaz O, Pliva M, Pudil J, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether catheter-directed thrombolysis improves clinical outcomes in patients with intermediate-high-risk pulmonary embolism, as compared with anticoagulation alone, is uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 與單獨抗凝相比，導管溶栓是否能改善中高風險肺栓塞患者的臨牀結果尚不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, open-label, randomized trial, we randomly assigned patients with intermediate-high-risk acute pulmonary embolism (defined by hemodynamic stability, a simplified Pulmonary Embolism Severity Index score of ≥1, and right ventricular dysfunction plus an elevated level of cardiac troponin or natriuretic peptide) in a 1:1 ratio to receive catheter-directed thrombolysis with alteplase plus anticoagulation therapy (thrombolysis group) or anticoagulation therapy alone (standard-care group). The primary outcome was a composite of death from any cause, recurrence of pulmonary embolism, or cardiorespiratory decompensation or collapse within 7 days after randomization. Secondary outcomes included clinically relevant bleeding as defined by the Bleeding Academic Research Consortium, major bleeding as defined in the Global Use of Strategies to Open Occluded Coronary Arteries guidelines, and intracranial hemorrhage.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、開放標籤、隨機試驗中，我們以1: 1的比例將中高風險急性肺栓塞(定義為血液動力學穩定性、簡化肺栓塞嚴重指數評分≥ 1 ，以及右心室功能障礙加上心肌肌鈣蛋白或利鈉肽水平升高)的患者隨機分組，接受導管定向溶栓加alteplase加抗凝療法(溶栓組)或單獨抗凝療法(標準護理組)。主要結果是隨機分組後7天內因任何原因死亡、肺栓塞復發、心肺失代償或衰竭的綜合結果。次要結果包括Bleeding Academic Research Consortium定義的臨牀相關出血、Global Use of Strategies to Open Occluded Coronary Arteries指南定義的重大出血，以及顱內出血。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 558 patients underwent randomization; 280 were assigned to the thrombolysis group, and 278 to the standard-care group. The median age was 64 years, and 40.9% were female. A primary-outcome event occurred in 2 patients (0.7%) in the thrombolysis group and in 19 patients (6.8%) in the standard-care group (relative risk, 0.10; 95% confidence interval, 0.02 to 0.44; P<0.001); this difference was driven mainly by the lower incidence of cardiorespiratory decompensation or collapse in the thrombolysis group. By day 7, clinically relevant bleeding had occurred in 13 patients (4.6%) in the thrombolysis group and in 14 patients (5.0%) in the standard-care group (P = 0.85); major bleeding in 4 (1.4%) and 6 (2.2%), respectively (P = 0.54); and intracranial hemorrhage in 2 (0.7%) and none. One patient in the thrombolysis group died within 30 days, and 4 patients in the standard-care group died within 7 days.
abstract.textZh: 共有558名患者接受了隨機分組； 280名患者被分配到溶栓組， 278名患者被分配到標準護理組。中位數年齡為64歲，女性為40.9%。溶栓組的2名患者（ 0.7% ）和標準護理組的19名患者（ 6.8% ）發生了主要結局事件（相對風險， 0.10 ； 95%置信區間， 0.02至0.44 ； P < 0.001 ） ；這種差異主要是由溶栓組的心肺失代償或崩潰發生率較低所致。到第7天，溶栓組13名患者（ 4.6% ）和標準護理組14名患者（ 5.0% ）出現臨牀相關出血（ P = 0.85 ） ；分別有4名（ 1.4% ）和6名（ 2.2% ）大出血（ P = 0.54 ） ；顱內出血2名（ 0.7% ）和無出血。溶栓組1例患者在30天內死亡，標準護理組4例患者在7天內死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with intermediate-high-risk acute pulmonary embolism, catheter-directed thrombolysis with alteplase plus anticoagulation therapy led to a lower risk of death from any cause, recurrent pulmonary embolism, or cardiorespiratory decompensation or collapse within 7 days after randomization than anticoagulation therapy alone. (Funded by the Ministry of Health of the Czech Republic and others; PRAGUE-26 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05493163; EudraCT number, 2022-002218-18; European Union Clinical Trials number, 2024-516144-25-00.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有中高風險急性肺栓塞的患者中，與單獨抗凝療法相比，導管直接溶栓加阿替普酶加抗凝療法導致隨機化後7天內任何原因死亡、復發性肺栓塞或心肺失代償或崩潰的風險較低。（由捷克共和國衛生部和其他部門資助； PRAGUE-26 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05493163 ； EudraCT編號， 2022-002218-18 ；歐盟臨牀試驗編號， 2024-516144-25-00。）。

articles.title: Immediate Ambulatory Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Syncope
articles.authors: Reed MJ, Goodacre S, Weir CJ, Dinsmore L, Nugent A, Kennel T, Lang CC, Grubb NR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with syncope who present to the emergency department for evaluation, diagnosing an underlying cardiac arrhythmia remains difficult.
abstract.textZh: 在急診室進行評估的暈厥患者中，診斷潛在的心律失常仍然很困難。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted an open-label, randomized, controlled trial at 45 hospitals in the United Kingdom to assess the effects of 14-day cardiac monitoring on diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes among patients with syncope. Adults with syncope that remained unexplained after an evaluation in the emergency department were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to undergo 14-day ambulatory electrocardiographic (ECG) monitoring (the intervention group) or to receive the standard care provided for patients with unexplained syncope at each participating site (the standard-care group). The primary outcome was the mean number of patient-reported episodes of syncope at 1 year.
abstract.textZh: 我們在英國45家醫院進行了一項開放標籤、隨機、對照試驗，以評估14天心臟監測對暈厥患者的診斷、治療和結果的影響。在急診科進行評估後仍無法解釋的暈厥成人，以1: 1的比例被分配接受14天的動態心電圖(ECG)監測(幹預組) ，或接受每個參與部位為無法解釋的暈厥患者提供的標準護理(標準護理組)。主要結果是1年時患者報告的暈厥發作次數的平均值。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 2234 patients underwent randomization: 1123 were assigned to the intervention group and 1111 to the standard-care group. The mean age of the patients was 58.3 years, and 52.1% were male. After the exclusion of patients who did not complete any follow-up, a total of 1970 patients (1004 in the intervention group and 966 in the standard-care group) were included in the primary analysis. The mean (±SD) number of patient-reported syncope episodes at 1 year was 1.37±5.10 in the intervention group and 1.58±8.56 in the standard-care group (incidence rate ratio, 0.89; 95% confidence interval, 0.68 to 1.18; P = 0.42). A total of 49 adverse events were reported in the intervention group, and 8 adverse events were reported in the standard-care group, with 1 serious adverse event in each group.
abstract.textZh: 共有2234名患者接受了隨機分組： 1123名患者被分配到幹預組， 1111名患者被分配到標準護理組。患者的平均年齡為58.3歲， 52.1%為男性。在排除未完成任何隨訪的患者後，共有1970名患者（幹預組1004名和標準護理組966名）被納入主要療效分析。介入組和標準護理組1年患者報告暈厥發作的平均(± SD)次數分別為1.37 ± 5.10和1.58 ± 8.56 (發生率比率， 0.89 ； 95%置信區間， 0.68至1.18 ； P = 0.42)。介入組共報告49例不良事件，標準護理組報告8例不良事件，每組1例嚴重不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with syncope that remained unexplained after evaluation in the emergency department, the use of 14-day ambulatory ECG monitoring did not result in significantly fewer patient-reported syncope episodes at 1 year than standard care. (Funded by the British Heart Foundation and National Health Service Research Scotland; ASPIRED ISRCTN Registry number, ISRCTN10278811.).
abstract.textZh: 在急診科評估後仍無法解釋的暈厥患者中，使用14天的動態ECG監測並未導致患者報告的1年暈厥發作顯著少於標準護理。（由英國心臟基金會和蘇格蘭國家衛生服務研究資助； ASPIRED ISRCTN註冊號碼， ISRCTN10278811。）。

articles.title: Adult Overweight and Obesity Management: Updates From the 2025 U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and U.S. Department of Defense Clinical Practice Guidelines
articles.authors: Corrado RL, Raffa SD, Bauer EM, Eisenberg D, Weare-Regales N, Antonovich N, Loblack A, Berdiel E, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: Obesity is a chronic, relapsing neurohormonal disease associated with substantial morbidity, mortality, and health care burden among U.S. veterans and active-duty service members. Advances in obesity assessment and treatments since publication of the 2020 clinical practice guideline (CPG) on management of adult overweight and obesity from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) prompted an update of the guideline. This synopsis highlights key 2025 recommendations that are relevant to primary care practice.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The VA/DoD Evidence-Based Practice Work Group (WG) convened a multidisciplinary panel of clinical stakeholders to update the guideline. A systematic review of evidence published from 1 April 2019 through 6 January 2025 was conducted to address 12 key questions developed using the PICOTS (population, intervention, comparator, outcomes, timing of outcomes measurement, and setting) framework. An independent third party reviewed the evidence. Recommendations were formulated using GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) methods, incorporating evidence quality; benefits and harms; patient values informed by focus groups; and consideration of resources, equity, acceptability, and feasibility.

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: The WG suggests routine screening for overweight and obesity in all adults based on a body mass index of 25 kg/m2 or higher (≥23 kg/m2 for Asian adults) along with waist circumference and clinical context to refine risk. The WG strongly recommends comprehensive lifestyle intervention (CLI) as the foundation of care. There was insufficient evidence to recommend for or against delaying pharmacotherapy relative to CLI and no requirement to complete CLI before initiating additional treatments. The guideline supports flexible, individualized integration of pharmacotherapy and CLI and discourages discontinuation of effective medications to prevent weight regain. New and updated recommendations address medications containing glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, endoscopic therapies, and metabolic and bariatric surgery, promoting patient-centered, stigma-informed, longitudinal care tailored to veterans and service members.

articles.title: Longitudinal Changes in Heart Stress and the Risk for Cardiovascular Disease and Mortality in Older Adults : An Observational Study
articles.authors: Cai A, Bayes-Genis A, Wolfe R, Tonkin AM, Zhu C, Januzzi JL, Zheng J, Nelson MR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Age-specific elevation in N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) concentrations, previously termed "heart stress (HS)," has been associated with adverse cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes. Yet, HS status, as defined by longitudinal changes in NT-proBNP concentrations, may improve risk assessment for CVD and mortality in older adults.
abstract.textZh: N末端B型前利鈉肽（ NT-proBNP ）濃度（以前稱為「心臟壓力（ HS ）」）的年齡特異性升高與不良心血管疾病（ CVD ）結果有關。然而，由NT-proBNP濃度的縱向變化定義的HS狀態可能會改善老年人心血管疾病和死亡率的風險評估。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate HS status on the basis of 3-year changes in NT-proBNP concentrations with risk for total CVD and all-cause mortality in community-dwelling older adults free of prior CVD.
abstract.textZh: 根據NT-proBNP濃度的3年變化評估HS狀態，該變化在沒有既往CVD的社區居住老年人中具有總CVD和全因死亡率的風險。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Observational study.
abstract.textZh: 觀察性研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: The ASPREE (ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly) trial and subsequent observational extension (ASPREE-XT).
abstract.textZh: ASPREE （減少老年人事件的ASPirin ）試驗和隨後的觀察擴展（ ASPREE-XT ）。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 8454 participants (mean age, 78.0 years at year 3; 52.9% women) without prior CVD who had NT-proBNP measured at trial enrollment and year 3.
abstract.textZh: 8454名參與者（平均年齡，第3年78.0歲； 52.9%婦女）在試驗入組和第3年進行NT-proBNP測量。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Heart stress status, based on changes in NT-proBNP concentrations from enrollment to year 3, was examined in 4 categories: persistently HS-free, HS remission, incident HS, or sustained HS. The 2 coprimary outcomes were total CVD (nonfatal myocardial infarction, fatal or nonfatal stroke, coronary heart disease death, or heart failure hospitalization) and all-cause mortality.
abstract.textZh: 基於NT-proBNP濃度從入組到第3年的變化，在4個類別中檢查了心臟應激狀態：持續無HS、HS緩解、事故HS或持續HS。2個共主要結果是總CVD （非致命性心肌梗死、致命性或非致命性中風、冠心病死亡或心力衰竭住院）和全因死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Over a median follow-up of 8.0 years, 818 CVD events and 1584 deaths occurred. At year 8, compared with the persistently HS-free category, the adjusted absolute risks (ARs) for total CVD were increased by 7.4% (95% CI, 4.8% to 10.0%) for incident HS and 6.7% (CI, 4.3% to 9.0%) for sustained HS; adjusted ARs were also increased for all-cause mortality by 6.1% (CI, 3.7% to 8.5%) for incident HS and 7.5% (CI, 5.2% to 9.8%) for sustained HS. The HS remission category had similar adjusted ARs to those of the persistently HS-free group.
abstract.textZh: 在8.0年的中位隨訪期間，發生了818例CVD事件和1584例死亡。在第8年，與持續無HS類別相比，總心血管疾病的調整絕對風險（ AR ）發生時增加了7.4 ％ （ 95 ％ CI ， 4.8 ％至10.0 ％ ） ，持續HS增加了6.7 ％ （ CI ， 4.3 ％至9.0 ％ ） ；全因死亡率調整AR發生時增加了6.1 ％ （ CI ， 3.7 ％至8.5 ％ ） ，持續HS增加了7.5 ％ （ CI ， 5.2 ％至9.8 ％ ）。HS緩解類別的調整不良反應與持續無HS組相似。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Observational design and predominantly White participants.
abstract.textZh: 觀察設計和主要是白人參與者。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Heart stress status based on longitudinal changes in NT-proBNP concentration may improve risk stratification of CVD and mortality.
abstract.textZh: 基於NT-proBNP濃度的縱向變化的心臟應激狀態可能會改善CVD的風險分層和死亡率。
